rules.claim_falsification: A claim is FALSIFIED if any fixture/config violates it (C1: any SHUTDOWN; C2: max(realized exposure) > 0.1575; C3: one gap event loses > 15 % of equity; C4: min(equity/hwm) < 0.82; C5: any buy fill while V3 state is FLAT_COOLDOWN or SHUTDOWN). A correct SHUTDOWN is NOT a software failure; it falsifies C1.
rules.harness_defects: Test-harness defects (crashes, unit errors, a fixture not producing its declared event) may be corrected transparently with the acceptance rules and predictions unchanged; the correction is reported.
rules.recommendation_rule: Recommend NO-GO for registration if the overlap audit finds only a risk overlay on already evaluated components (no distinct return hypothesis), regardless of fixture outcome. Fixture results can only weaken the case further; they cannot create a GO by themselves.
rules.stop: One run of each fixture and config. No new fixtures, parameters, caps, estimators or inference methods after results; no M5 reopening; no market data; no registration; N 45/52 and families 1/3 unchanged.
rules.withdrawal: A falsified guarantee is withdrawn in the report; no replacement strategy, cap or parameter is tuned.
